description:
Get onlineMeetings from copilot

TIP: Lists meetings where this AI user has Copilot insights available (meeting summary, action items, key topics generated by Copilot). One entry per meeting Copilot processed. Use to identify which meetings have AI-generated recaps to retrieve via list-ai-meeting-insights. Supports $filter (e.g. on date), $top, $skip, $orderby.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-ai-user-online-meetings
